title: Shared Incident SOP v1
content:
## Shared Incident SOP v1

Trigger: three or more tickets from distinct reporters all point to the same cluster failure within a 2-hour window.

Steps:
1. Read all open tickets and identify the cluster name.
2. Tag each incident ticket with: sev1-correlated, cross-team-verified
3. Set priority=critical and category=cluster-incident on all cluster tickets.
4. Add an internal note on each: 'SOP-F01 applied — awaiting root-cause owner assignment'
5. Do not close any ticket — leave resolution to on-call.
6. Output one line per ticket: TICKET_ID|priority|category|why

Exclusions:
- Requests, training tickets, and same-system low-impact issues are NOT cluster incidents.
- Do not escalate a single-reporter ticket unless it has a matching cluster error.
- Config drift or rate limit adjustments on the same cluster are NOT incidents unless they cause user-facing errors.
